desc:
Rocket Blox is a fast-paced car soccer game where speed, precision, and teamwork make the difference. Get behind the wheel, boost across the arena, and take to the skies to score spectacular goals and make crucial saves.

Team up with friends, master the mechanics, and customize your car to match your style. Complete challenges to earn Fragments and XP, and grow your collection.

⚽ Compete in action-packed car soccer matches.
🚗 Unlock cars and items.
🎨 Customize your car with wheels, decals, boosts, and painted items.
💎 Earn Fragments by completing daily and weekly challenges.
👥 Play with your friends and work together to win.
🖥️📱🎮 Available on PC, mobile, and console.

Are you ready to bring the hype?!

Rocket Blox is still under development. Share your feedback and report bugs to help us improve the game.
Thanks for playing! If you enjoy Rocket Blox, please like it and add it to your favorites.

League - Cars - Rockets - Soccer - Training - 1v1 - 2v2 - Football - Ball - Goal
